title: ampelocissus leonensis
intro: Ampelocissus leonensis, commonly known as African vine, is a plant species belonging to the Vitaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ampelocissus leonensis include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and antimalarial properties, as well as its potential use in treating fever and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
